senses.gloss: (b. h.;קדד, cmp. גַּד II, כַּד II; Assyr. ḳaḳḳadu)head, skull, vertex; summit.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:10">Neg. X, 10</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="C00070"><he>גַּבַּחַת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 37a:6">Men. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>בין עיניך זו ק׳</he> ‘between thy eyes’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:8">Deut. VI, 8</cite>), that means the vertex; expl.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:8">ib.</cite> <he>מקום וכ׳</he> the place on the head where the child’s brain is seen to pulsate; (<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 35:12">Sifré Deut. 35</cite> <he>בגובה של ראש</he>); <cite ref="Eruvin 95b:17">Erub. 95ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62">Gen. R. s. 62</cite>, end <he>בא מקָדְקֳדוֹ של מדבר</he> he came all the way from the highest point of the desert.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:18">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII, 4</cite> (expl. <he>גיא צלמות</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:18">ib.</cite>) <he>בק׳ של מדבר</he>; a. e.—Pl. <he>קָדְקֳדִים</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:5">Lev. R. s. 9</cite>; s. 25, a. e. <he>בקָדְקֳדֵי ראשיהן</he> by the tops of their heads.
